title: TomeStack campaign profile (schemaVersion 1)
description: SPEC P-01, BACKLOG B12 (M2 item 7): a local campaign with its rules family, the sources its characters may use, and free-text house rules. It never changes calculation; content outside the allowed sources is flagged on the character unless an exception is recorded. Unknown properties round-trip. M6 slice 2 documents the optional pendingSources, which changes how no existing field is read, so the version stays 1 (schemas/README.md 'Versioning rules').

pendingSources.description: M6 slice 2 (optional; older builds round-trip it as an unknown property): allowed sources a campaign pack left out that are not installed here yet, with the title, publisher and license the pack named. Each is also in allowedSources. Not written when empty.
